<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro" name="$(arg robot_name)">
  <xacro:arg name="robot_name" default="drone_0"/>
  <xacro:arg name="low_resource" default="true"/>
  <xacro:property name="lite" value="$(arg low_resource)"/>
  <xacro:property name="robot_name" value="$(arg robot_name)"/>
  <link name="base_footprint"/>
  <joint name="base_joint" type="fixed"><parent link="base_footprint"/><child link="base_link"/></joint>
  <link name="base_link">
    <inertial><mass value="1.75"/><inertia ixx="0.035" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.035" iyz="0" izz="0.055"/></inertial>
    <visual><geometry><box size="0.32 0.22 0.10"/></geometry><material name="drone_blue"><color rgba="0.08 0.25 0.72 1"/></material></visual>
    <collision><geometry><box size="0.32 0.22 0.10"/></geometry></collision>
  </link>
  <xacro:macro name="arm" params="name x y index direction">
    <link name="${name}_rotor">
      <inertial><mass value="0.04"/><inertia ixx="0.0002" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.0002" iyz="0" izz="0.0004"/></inertial>
      <visual><geometry><cylinder radius="0.13" length="0.012"/></geometry><material name="rotor"><color rgba="0.1 0.1 0.1 0.8"/></material></visual>
      <collision><geometry><cylinder radius="0.13" length="0.012"/></geometry></collision>
    </link>
    <joint name="${name}_joint" type="continuous"><parent link="base_link"/><child link="${name}_rotor"/><origin xyz="${x} ${y} 0.10"/><axis xyz="0 0 1"/><dynamics damping="0" friction="0"/></joint>
    <gazebo>
      <plugin filename="gz-sim-multicopter-motor-model-system" name="gz::sim::systems::MulticopterMotorModel">
        <robotNamespace>${robot_name}</robotNamespace>
        <jointName>${name}_joint</jointName><linkName>${name}_rotor</linkName>
        <turningDirection>${direction}</turningDirection>
        <timeConstantUp>0.025</timeConstantUp><timeConstantDown>0.05</timeConstantDown>
        <maxRotVelocity>1000</maxRotVelocity><motorConstant>8.54858e-6</motorConstant><momentConstant>0.016</momentConstant>
        <commandSubTopic>command/motor_speed</commandSubTopic><actuator_number>${index}</actuator_number>
        <rotorDragCoefficient>8.06428e-5</rotorDragCoefficient><rollingMomentCoefficient>1e-6</rollingMomentCoefficient>
        <rotorVelocitySlowdownSim>10</rotorVelocitySlowdownSim><motorType>velocity</motorType>
      </plugin>
    </gazebo>
  </xacro:macro>
  <xacro:arm name="front_left" x="0.25" y="0.25" index="0" direction="ccw"/><xacro:arm name="rear_right" x="-0.25" y="-0.25" index="1" direction="ccw"/>
  <xacro:arm name="front_right" x="0.25" y="-0.25" index="2" direction="cw"/><xacro:arm name="rear_left" x="-0.25" y="0.25" index="3" direction="cw"/>
  <link name="sensor_link"><inertial><mass value="0.05"/><inertia ixx="0.0001" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.0001" iyz="0" izz="0.0001"/></inertial></link>
  <joint name="sensor_joint" type="fixed"><parent link="base_link"/><child link="sensor_link"/><origin xyz="0 0 -0.07"/></joint>
  <gazebo reference="sensor_link">
    <sensor name="planar_lidar" type="gpu_lidar"><frame_id>${robot_name}/sensor_link</frame_id><topic>/${robot_name}/scan</topic><update_rate>${5 if lite else 10}</update_rate><always_on>true</always_on><lidar><scan><horizontal><samples>${180 if lite else 360}</samples><resolution>1</resolution><min_angle>-3.14159</min_angle><max_angle>3.14159</max_angle></horizontal></scan><range><min>0.15</min><max>12</max><resolution>0.03</resolution></range></lidar></sensor>
    <sensor name="downward_range" type="gpu_lidar"><frame_id>${robot_name}/sensor_link</frame_id><pose>0 0 0 0 1.5708 0</pose><topic>/${robot_name}/altitude</topic><update_rate>20</update_rate><always_on>true</always_on><lidar><scan><horizontal><samples>1</samples><min_angle>0</min_angle><max_angle>0</max_angle></horizontal></scan><range><min>0.1</min><max>10</max><resolution>0.01</resolution></range></lidar></sensor>
    <sensor name="downward_camera" type="camera"><frame_id>${robot_name}/sensor_link</frame_id><pose>0 0 0 0 1.5708 0</pose><topic>/${robot_name}/downward_camera</topic><update_rate>${3 if lite else 15}</update_rate><always_on>true</always_on><camera><horizontal_fov>1.2</horizontal_fov><image><width>${320 if lite else 640}</width><height>${240 if lite else 480}</height><format>R8G8B8</format></image><clip><near>0.1</near><far>30</far></clip></camera></sensor>
    <sensor name="imu" type="imu"><frame_id>${robot_name}/sensor_link</frame_id><topic>/${robot_name}/imu/data</topic><update_rate>100</update_rate><always_on>true</always_on></sensor>
  </gazebo>
  <gazebo>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-multicopter-control-system" name="gz::sim::systems::MulticopterVelocityControl">
      <robotNamespace>${robot_name}</robotNamespace><commandSubTopic>cmd_vel</commandSubTopic>
      <comLinkName>base_footprint</comLinkName>
      <velocityGain>2.7 2.7 3</velocityGain><attitudeGain>2 2 0.15</attitudeGain><angularRateGain>0.4 0.4 0.18</angularRateGain>
      <maximumLinearAcceleration>1 1 1</maximumLinearAcceleration>
      <maximumLinearVelocity>1.5 1.5 0.7</maximumLinearVelocity><maximumAngularVelocity>1 1 0.4</maximumAngularVelocity>
      <rotorConfiguration>
        <rotor><jointName>front_left_joint</jointName><forceConstant>8.54858e-6</forceConstant><momentConstant>0.016</momentConstant><direction>1</direction></rotor>
        <rotor><jointName>rear_right_joint</jointName><forceConstant>8.54858e-6</forceConstant><momentConstant>0.016</momentConstant><direction>1</direction></rotor>
        <rotor><jointName>front_right_joint</jointName><forceConstant>8.54858e-6</forceConstant><momentConstant>0.016</momentConstant><direction>-1</direction></rotor>
        <rotor><jointName>rear_left_joint</jointName><forceConstant>8.54858e-6</forceConstant><momentConstant>0.016</momentConstant><direction>-1</direction></rotor>
      </rotorConfiguration>
    </plugin>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-joint-state-publisher-system" name="gz::sim::systems::JointStatePublisher"><topic>/${robot_name}/joint_states</topic><update_rate>20</update_rate></plugin>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-odometry-publisher-system" name="gz::sim::systems::OdometryPublisher">
      <odom_topic>/${robot_name}/odom</odom_topic><tf_topic>/${robot_name}/tf</tf_topic><odom_frame>${robot_name}/odom</odom_frame><robot_base_frame>${robot_name}/base_footprint</robot_base_frame><odom_publish_frequency>30</odom_publish_frequency><dimensions>3</dimensions>
    </plugin>
  </gazebo>
</robot>
